description: The stock user editor's banner (ShowManagedNoticeOnUserPages): the sandbox's admin while accessroles-web-guard-probe.mjs gives viewer the probe's Kid role and makes it the default role. The stock Library access tab of viewer shows Access Roles' banner (the role, the library rule, the locked sections) first in the page, as text; viewer2's profile tab (not managed) has none; Add user names the default role. The admin's own /Me locks nothing and the guard hides nothing. Reads only.

steps.name: no lock class for an administrator
viewer's and viewer2's ids
steps.eval: (async () => { const users = await ApiClient.getUsers(); const id = (n) => (users.find((u) => u.Name === n) || {}).Id; return { viewer: id('viewer'), viewer2: id('viewer2') }; })()

steps.name: viewer's Library access tab
steps.script: Dashboard.navigate('dashboard/users/access?userId=' + __vars.ids.viewer); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 3000)); return location.hash;

steps.name: the banner is first in the page
the role, the library rule and the locked sections, as text
steps.assert: /Guard probe Kid/.test(__vars.banner[0]) && __vars.banner.some((t) => /changes to it on this page are replaced/.test(t)) && __vars.banner.some((t) => /Profile/.test(t) && /Home screen/.test(t)) && [...document.querySelector('#userLibraryAccessPage:not(.hide) [data-jfar-banner]').querySelectorAll('*')].every((e) => e.tagName === 'P')

steps.name: viewer2's profile tab (not managed)
steps.script: Dashboard.navigate('dashboard/users/profile?userId=' + __vars.ids.viewer2); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 3000)); return location.hash;

steps.name: no banner for an unmanaged user
Add user
steps.script: Dashboard.navigate('dashboard/users/add'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 3000)); return location.hash;

steps.name: the default role's banner
steps.waitFor: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('#newUserPage:not(.hide) .content-primary [data-jfar-banner]'); return !!b && /default roles: Guard probe Kid/.test(b.textContent); })()

steps.name: no uncaught exceptions (the stale CustomRatings tag excepted)
